synthesis.procedure: Treatment of [Sm(AliBu4)2] (1Sm) with hexachloroethane gave the mixed-valence cluster.

synthesis.procedure: Treatment of [Yb(AliBu4)2] (1Yb) with hexachloroethane afforded cluster 4, which co-crystallized with unreacted precursor. The article does not give a numerical reagent amount for this preparation in the main text.

synthesis.temperature: −40 °C for crystallization; reaction temperature not specified
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The cluster co-crystallized with precursor 1Yb; purification was reported to be hampered by their similar solubility.
